sparql:
PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?quantityKind ?quantityKindLabel
WHERE {
  # paper to its template contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?paperContribution .
  # contribution to the Quantity template instance
  ?paperContribution orkgp:PWC_HAS_BENCHMARK ?contribution .
  # restrict to the Quantity template class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C23007 .
  # the hasQuantityKind reported by the paper
  ?contribution orkgp:P45074 ?quantityKind .
  # resolve paper title
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
  # resolve quantity kind label
  OPTIONAL { ?quantityKind rdfs:label ?quantityKindLabel }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel ?quantityKindLabel

PREFIX orkgr: <http://orkg.org/orkg/resource/>
PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?objective ?objectiveLabel
WHERE {
  # paper linked to its contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  # restrict contributions to this template class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C112000 .
  # accept both the declared and the commonly used objective predicate
  VALUES ?objectiveProperty { orkgp:P67098 orkgp:P107003 }
  # the objective reported for this paper
  ?contribution ?objectiveProperty ?objective .
  # paper title
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
  # objective label
  OPTIONAL { ?objective rdfs:label ?objectiveLabel }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel

PREFIX orkgc: <http://orkg.org/orkg/class/>
PREFIX orkgp: <http://orkg.org/orkg/predicate/>
PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#>
SELECT DISTINCT ?paper ?paperLabel ?metricValue
WHERE {
  # paper linked to its contribution
  ?paper orkgp:P31 ?contribution .
  # restrict to this template class
  ?contribution a orkgc:C114000 .
  # accept the declared and the commonly used metric predicate
  VALUES ?metricProperty { orkgp:P2006 orkgp:HAS_METRIC }
  # the metric reported by the paper
  ?contribution ?metricProperty ?metric .
  # metrics may be resources or plain literals, resolve labels where present
  OPTIONAL { ?metric rdfs:label ?metricLabel }
  BIND(COALESCE(STR(?metricLabel), STR(?metric)) AS ?metricValue)
  # paper title
  OPTIONAL { ?paper rdfs:label ?paperLabel }
}
ORDER BY ?paperLabel ?metricValue

  # restrict to the Schema.org SoftwareApplication class

  # paper title
